about: The lead's judgements of QS4h's live runs on deepseek-flash, four passes of the eight items (two of h1's real tip, which lost three of its five runs), each checked by verifier-JH (Sonnet), recorded as judgement (AMENDMENT-1.md, A1.5). One entry per plant of a planted run (caught or missed: whether a finding of that run states the plant's own fault, wherever it cites; the screen's located and stated flags are the table's other column), and one per finding of a run besides a plant's, against this round's recorded verifier findings as qs4h_items.json lists them: a match, with the recorded finding's id in `recorded`; new and true (absent from that list, and true at the run's commit; a note says where a lead or verifier had seen it outside the list, and a note that begins 'replay' marks a finding true of the run's inputs, not of the parcel's work, counted apart); or a false alarm (false, or a misreading). Each names the run's record_id, who judged and who checked, and a note in the judge's own words, never the model's text. Runs left out of the score, and why, are in the table's selection file.
